==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|original}}, from {{der|en|fro|original}}, from {{der|en|la-lat|orīginālis|t=primitive, original}}, from {{der|en|la|orīgō|t=beginning, source, origin}}, equivalent to {{af|en|origin|-al}}; see [[origin]].

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/əˈɹɪd͡ʒ.ɪ.nəl/|/əˈɹɪd͡ʒ.ə.nəl/|/əˈɹɪd͡ʒ.nəl/|a=RP,GA,CA,AU}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-original.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/əˈɹəd͡ʒ.ə.nəl/|/əˈɹəd͡ʒ.nəl/|a=NZ}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɒˈɹɪd͡ʒ.ɪ.nəl/<q:obsolete><ref:{{R:Jespersen MEGoHP|I|13.28|362}}>}}
* {{hyph|en|o|rig|i|nal}}, {{hyph|en|orig|i|nal|nocaption=1}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj}}

# {{lb|en|not comparable}} Relating to the origin or beginning; preceding all others.
#: {{syn|en|primary}}
#: {{ux|en|the '''original''' state of mankind;  the '''original''' laws of a country;  the '''original''' inventor of a process}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1944|author={{w|Cecil Street|Miles Burton}}
|url=https://openlibrary.org/works/OL10563347W|title=The Three Corpse Trick|chapter=5|ol=10563347W|isbn=9780860250371|oclc=3289313
|passage=The hovel stood in the centre of what had once been a vegetable garden, but was now a patch of rank weeds. Surrounding this, almost like a zareba, was an irregular ring of gorse and brambles, an unclaimed vestige of the '''original''' common.}}
# {{lb|en|not comparable}} {{U|first}} in a series of copies or versions.
#: {{syn|en|initial|primary}}
#: {{ux|en|The '''original''' manuscript contained spelling errors which were fixed in later versions.}}
#: {{ux|en|This recording is by the '''original''' broadway cast.}}
#* {{RQ:Allingham China Governess|chapter=1|passage=The '''original''' family who had begun to build a palace to rival Nonesuch had died out before they had put up little more than the gateway,{{nb...}}.}}
# {{lb|en|not comparable}} Newly created.
#: {{ux|en|Tonight we will hear an '''original''' work by one of our best composers.}}
# {{lb|en|comparable}} {{U|fresh}}, [[different]].
#: {{ux|en|The paper contains a number of '''original''' ideas about color perception.}}
#* {{quote-journal
|en
|date=February 23, 2017
|author=Katie Rife
|title=''The Girl With All The Gifts'' tries to put a fresh spin on overripe zombie clichés
|work=w:The Onion AV Club
|url=http://www.avclub.com/review/girl-all-gifts-tries-put-fresh-spin-overripe-zombi-250838
|page=
|passage=Devoid of context, the image is intriguing, promising something utterly '''original''' and deeply fucked up.
|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170818062631/http://www.avclub.com/review/girl-all-gifts-tries-put-fresh-spin-overripe-zombi-250838}}
# {{lb|en|not comparable}} {{U|pioneering}}.
#: {{ux|en|Parker was one of the '''original''' bebop players.}}
# {{lb|en|not comparable}} Having a specified place or time as its origin.
#: {{ux|en|This kind of barbecue is '''original''' to North Carolina.}}
# {{lb|en|of [[food]]}} Unseasoned, unflavored, [[plain]], or having a standard or typical flavor; [[classic]], [[traditional]]

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# An [[object]] or other [[creation]] (e.g. narrative [[work]]) from which all later [[copies]] and variations are [[derive]]d.
#: {{synonyms|en|prototype}}
#: {{antonyms|en|copy|derivative|remake|reproduction|ultimate}}
#: {{hyponyms|en|autograph}}
#: {{ux|en|This manuscript is the '''original'''.}}
# A person with a unique and interesting personality or creative talent.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1700|author={{w|Tom Brown (satirist)|Tom Brown}}|title=Amusements Serious and Comical, calculated for the Meridian of London|page=5
|passage=I have a great mind to be in Print; but above all, I would fain be an '''Original''', and that is a true Comical Thought: When all the Learned Men in the World are but Tranſlators, is it not a Pleaſant Jeſt, that you ſhould ſtrive to be an '''Original'''! You ſhould have obſerved your Time, and have come into the World with the Ancient ''Greeks'' for that purpoſe; for the ''Latines'' themſelves are but Copies.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=1975|journal=The Educational Trends|volume=10-14|page=59
|passage=Ahmad (1969) studied the personality differences among middle school girls identified as '''originals''' and unoriginals on the Minnesota's test of creative thinking.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2010|author=A. Kusuma|title=Creativity and Cognitive Styles in Children|page=73
|passage=The '''originals''' or the creatives were more dominant than the unoriginals or the low creatives.}}
# {{lb|en|archaic}} An [[eccentric]] person.
#* {{RQ:Conrad Heart of Darkness|page=201|passage=‘Are you an alienist?’ I interrupted. ‘Every doctor should be - a little,’ answered that '''original''', imperturbably.}}
# A newly designed [[garment]] released by a [[fashion designer]] as part of a [[collection]].
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=1962|title=It's Fashion fair time again|journal=Ebony|volume=17|issue=11|page=126
|passage=Fashion Fair will give every section first hand knowledge of the latest '''originals''' and 1962-63's exciting trends.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1963|author=National Retail Merchants Association. Sales Promotion Division|title=The NRMA Sales Promotion Encyclopedia, Vol. II.|page=175
|passage=One such show was built around the Du Pont spring collection of Paris '''originals'''.}}
# A [[ridgeling]].
